_ambiguities: Prepend order is not asserted: titles and names are random and no op compares the order of two rendered questions. Only counts and structure are checked.
Unique name is checked only as the presence of an id attribute on each question root (count of fieldset.q[id]). Uniqueness and the name's format are not asserted.
Random title content is not asserted; only that the legend is visible (non-zero size, so non-empty).
Constructor semantics (preview default false, member root) are not callable from the UI; only the rendered root is checked.
The Question.js check matches the text 'class Question' and 'export' in the served raw source; the exact export form (named or default) is not pinned.
